messages:
Eli (Sales): Handing off Streamline Labs. Mid-market, signed 2024-08-02, 12mo. Dedicated eval in us-west. Onboarding ~60%. Main blockers: Okta SSO failing (tls cert issue) and bulk CSV ingest producing 5xx. Renewal flagged medium risk until stable.

Maya (CS): I will own onboarding + enablement. Need contacts and sanitized logs. Can we do enablement Thu 09:00 PT? Also they asked for a quick tour of model routing & cost controls.

Eli (Sales): Contacts: pete@streamline.ai (Platform lead), rina@streamline.ai (PM). Pete agreed to drop IdP metadata XML + one sanitized CSV in the shared folder. Intro email sent.

Ravi (Eng): Reproduced cert error: "x509: certificate signed by unknown authority". Opening ENG-9012. Fix is config update + restart of dedicated host. Need metadata XML or cert upload.

June (Support): Creating SUPPORT-4230 and adding synthetic monitor for ingest endpoints. Alert rule: page oncall + Ravi if 5xx >1% over 5m.

infra-bot: Maintenance request received for streamline-ded-01. Queue pos: 2. Confirm ETA in ENG-9012.

Maya (CS): Owners & next steps: Maya = onboarding/enablement + collect feedback; Ravi = ENG-9012 apply config & restart; June = SUPPORT-4230 monitors & escalation; Eli = customer liaison and confirm maintenance window. I'll create CS-1333 epic and link tickets.

Eli (Sales): Pete replied: uploading files now. Maintenance window Tue 15:00-16:00 PT; requests 20m pre-call.

Ravi (Eng): I can do restart Tue 15:10 PT after pre-call. Will post PR & health checks to ENG-9012.

June (Support): I'll standby during restart and escalate if 5xx spikes.

Maya (CS): Scheduling pre-call Tue 14:40 PT and enablement Thu 09:00 PT. I'll share a short feedback form after the session.

Eli (Sales): Marked renewal as "monitoring" in CRM and set 30-day adoption follow-up. Use this thread for quick updates. :thumbsup:
